name: Welcome on board
description: The car recognises the family and gets the cabin ready before anyone sits down.
story: Saturday morning, Camille walks to the E-Space with her father Jacques and the holiday luggage. The car recognises her phone, greets them with light, opens up and gets the cabin ready before anyone sits down.

name: Long trip with personal audio zones
description: Each passenger gets their own audio, while the driver never misses a navigation instruction.
story: On the motorway, Léa wants her game music, Jacques wants some quiet and Camille needs to hear the navigation. The seat speakers give each passenger their own audio zone. When the navigation speaks, everyone's audio is turned down so Camille hears the instruction.

name: Urban manoeuvre with steer-by-wire
description: Steer-by-wire makes a tight underground parking manoeuvre easy, then the car locks and says goodbye.
story: Back in Lyon, Camille parks in a tight underground car park. The half wheel switches to a direct parking ratio, so she can turn the wheels fully without crossing her hands. The sensors and the openR screen guide her. Once she is parked, the wheel stows and the car says goodbye.

name: Lounge stop while charging
description: A fast-charging stop turns the cabin into a lounge, then back to driving mode.
story: Two hours into the trip to the Alps, the family stops at a fast charger. Instead of waiting in a cafeteria, they turn the cabin into a lounge: the second-row seats turn to face the back, the console slides to the middle with cold drinks and games. When the battery is full, the car tells them and puts the cabin back in driving mode.
